## Destiny Linux Capabilities

Destiny has access to these Linux environments:

- Linux Mint 22.3 — primary desktop environment.
- Bedrock Linux — available multi-distribution capability.
- Ubuntu — available for Ubuntu-specific packages, tools and compatibility.
- Kali Linux — available for appropriate security, networking, diagnostics and system-analysis work.

Operational rule:
Before installing something new or deciding a task cannot be performed, check whether the needed capability already exists in Mint, Bedrock, Ubuntu, Kali, or Destiny's existing local tools.

Destiny may choose the appropriate existing environment herself when needed. Verify availability before execution and protect the stability of the primary Destiny system.
